sources.beginner: unobtainable: OKPARA-9 column values need the engine (DAK z, 96-step march, 64-sample chord); pd-column-explorer (panels/gaslift/ColumnExplorer.jsx) only selects the three published columns and the four published designs; the working-the-capstone lesson works westTexasOil, not the capstone; no Suite app is named
sources.intermediate: unobtainable: the spacing and valve settings need designGasLift on a 0.99 in2 bellows and a 9/32..9/16 port catalogue; pd-valve-explorer (ValveExplorer.jsx) selects published designs only; Suite GasLiftDesignStudio has fixed valve families and prints whole psig/ft
sources.advanced: unobtainable: closing surface pressures and the injection point need the full design plus the analytic traverse tabulated at 401/7 rows; pd-unloading-explorer (UnloadingExplorer.jsx) selects published designs and the teaching traverse only; the Suite studio builds its traverse from a well model and cannot take this one

fix.display: /root/wt-b5-nextgen/src/components/course/panels/gaslift/ColumnExplorer.jsx: add a learner-entered column mode (gas sg, wellhead T, bottom T, reference depth, surface pressure) that prints z with fmt(v, 8); note the existing fmt(r.z, 6) at :133 is itself too coarse (half unit 5e-7 > tol 4.2e-7)

fields.recommendation: Display fix: give the tier's panel a learner-entered case mode (inputs, not a capstone preset, so panelCapstoneGuard stays green) at six or more decimals. A tolerance change cannot help because no route prints the value at any precision. If the owner prefers not to extend the panels, the fallback is a redesign of the tier onto quantities the panels can read, which moves every graded value.
fields.evidence: z needs Newton iteration on DAK with Sutton criticals, none of whose coefficients the lessons state. Every gaslift panel is a SelectField over published/teaching cases only (ColumnExplorer.jsx:65,177,293,451; ValveExplorer.jsx:80; UnloadingExplorer.jsx:80,240) with no numeric inputs, and panelCapstoneGuard.test.js forbids the okpara* readers, so no panel can be set to OKPARA-9. Not a hand-calc: the lessons name Sutton pseudo-criticals and Dranchuk-Abou-Kassem (beginner m02/l02) and describe a predictor-trapezoid march (m05/l01) but never give the correlation coefficients or the engine's Rankine/constant conventions, and the tolerance is about 5e-7 relative, so only the engine itself reproduces it (the course itself shows a 4.4e-4 relative constant mismatch between textbook and engine, m02/l04).
fields.notes: Continuous value, tol 4.2e-07 absolute (about 5.0e-07 relative, so roughly seven significant figures needed); no prompt precision stated. Probe: no panel number within tol of this answer in any state (closest 0.1%-band near-misses are teaching values, e.g. UnloadingExplorer 1,214.7 psia vs valve1 closing; not leaks).
